<![CDATA[
declare @taxRate numeric(28, 6), @taxType int, @taxAccount varchar(32), @taxCode varchar(32)

Content:

declare @usedEI char(1), @eiStatus char(1), @eiAutoGenAnnouncement varchar(32), @eiAuthentication char(1)
select @usedEI = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_sd_hddt'
